portfolio/index.html: Research
MSM-Seg: Multi-Modal Brain Tumor Segmentation
Comparative 3D segmentation experiments on BraTS 2024 and BraTS 2025 for the MSM-Seg framework.
Conducted comprehensive comparative experiments by training and evaluating 3D segmentation models (nnU-Net, 3D-TransUNet, TransBTS, SIN2GR, UNETR++, and others) on BraTS 2024 and BraTS 2025 datasets.
Implemented standardized evaluation protocols in the BraTS-METS benchmark, measuring Dice and HD95 for ET, TC, and WT sub-regions.
Analyzed quantitative results to validate that MSM-Seg outperforms or matches all baselines, particularly under the category-agnostic prompting setting.
YOLOv8 and IoT Agricultural Pest Detection System
Undergraduate thesis combining embedded sensing, live video, and YOLOv8 pest detection.

Designed the embedded control architecture on an STM32F103C8T6 microcontroller, integrating DHT22 temperature and humidity sensing with an effective accumulated-temperature algorithm for automated SMS pest-outbreak alerts.
Configured an ESP32-S3-WROOM-1U WiFi module to stream live field video from the microcontroller node to a host-computer gateway for real-time processing.
Built the video ingestion and preprocessing pipeline with OpenCV to feed live field footage into the inference pipeline.
Fine-tuned and deployed a YOLOv8x model for real-time pest detection on the IP102 dataset, with results visualized through a PyQt5 interface backed by SQLite.
SO-101 Real-World Robotic Learning with LeRobot
End-to-end imitation learning on the Huaner SO-101 dual-arm platform using LeRobot.

Reproduced an end-to-end imitation-learning pipeline on the Huaner SO-101 dual-arm platform using the LeRobot framework, covering teleoperation data collection, SmolVLA policy training, and real-world deployment.
Configured the full software stack and performed source-level modifications to enable RGB multi-view perception and language-conditioned manipulation.
Diagnosed and resolved hardware setup, camera calibration, and inference failure cases through iterative debugging and validation.
Marso Hack Berlin 2026 – Robot Parcel Sorting Challenge
Imitation learning for simulated parcel sorting with ManiSkill3, SAPIEN, and a Franka Panda manipulator.
Completed an imitation-learning solution for a simulated robot parcel-sorting challenge using ManiSkill3, SAPIEN, and a Franka Panda manipulator.

Parsed and replayed expert demonstration trajectories stored in HDF5/JSON formats across easy, medium, and hard task settings, extracting observations, actions, environment states, and success labels for training and evaluation.
Established behavior-cloning baselines from state and RGB observations and evaluated State Diffusion Policy and RGB ACT policies in local rollout episodes.
Built the training and rollout pipeline and measured local policy performance by task success rate.
